description: Links detection output to hunt playbooks. One file, two readers: packages/web-server/src/services/huntCatalog.ts (alert feed + /api/v1/catalog/match) and agents/zeek-detector/pipeline/findings_generator.py (the `playbooks` field on every finding). Edit here, never in code. Order within a list is relevance order; readers dedupe and cap.

hunt_queries.PB-01: Are any hosts connecting to the same external destination on a regular interval today?
hunt_queries.PB-02: Are there any signs of DNS tunneling or DGA-style domain lookups in the last 24 hours?
hunt_queries.PB-03: Is there any lateral movement activity like SMB or RDP between internal hosts today?
hunt_queries.PB-04: Which internal hosts uploaded the most data to external destinations in the last 24 hours?
hunt_queries.PB-05: Are there any suspicious Kerberos authentication alerts today?
hunt_queries.PB-06: Are there any TLS connections with unusual fingerprints or certificates in the last 24 hours?
hunt_queries.PB-07: Were any executable or suspicious files downloaded over HTTP in the last 24 hours?
hunt_queries.PB-08: Which external IPs with the most alerts today are known bad infrastructure?
hunt_queries.PB-09: Which hosts are behaving abnormally compared to the rest of the network today?
hunt_queries.PB-10: Are there any signs of Cobalt Strike or other C2 framework activity on the network?
hunt_queries.PB-11: Are there any ransomware indicators like mass SMB file writes today?
hunt_queries.PB-12: Which hosts are port scanning or sweeping the network right now?
hunt_queries.PB-13: Which rare or suspicious HTTP user agents were seen in the last 24 hours?
hunt_queries.PB-14: Are there any protocol anomalies or weird traffic alerts in the last 24 hours?
hunt_queries.PB-15: Has any host on the network contacted a known malicious IOC in the last 24 hours?
hunt_queries.PB-16: Are there any remote execution attempts like WMI or WinRM between internal hosts today?
